proposal.boundedness: One observer per owned original document; one original cancellation per ended cycle, no rapid polling/new receiver/network fan-out. Pagehide disconnects observers and existing interval. Native failure flag is one-way for that receiver. Existing request IDs and old aliases retain the failed snapshot; a new explicit request does not alias a blocked session and can allocate a fresh original document under the unchanged admission limit. Old alias close cannot destroy that replacement. Closed/stale document callbacks cannot affect a replacement. Paint checks the failure flag both before and after reserving its revision: a preceding block prevents enqueue and a later block invalidates the queued paint, without holding a session mutex across native/UI dispatch.

capacityAddendum.finding: Independent root review found parent open_vod exempts existing contains_video from the combined4-document limit, but blocked receivers are now intentionally not reusable. At capacity, the same video with a blocked old receiver could therefore allocate a fifth. Merely switching the parent predicate is insufficient: SourceChanged can block a previously reusable receiver between the parent check and WatchHost::open.
capacityAddendum.decision: Preserve contains_video's existing LIVE duplicate-identity meaning. Remove the redundant parent reuse exemption rather than adding a second reusable predicate. Under the existing parent provider admission lock compute can_create_document from actual live+watch document count and pass this private permit to WatchHost::open. Its registry-local reuse_or_admit helper returns the latest reusable same-video session, otherwise rejects creation when this immutable permit is false. A receiver blocked after the parent count therefore yields an error, not a fifth document. Idempotent existing requests remain failed snapshots, not new allocations; a reusable alias still requires no new document.
